name: TOTP Recovery Code Rotation Flow Handler
summary: Provides the typed application boundary for replacing recovery codes while preserving an enrolled TOTP factor.
notes: The handler owns the enabled-TOTP guard and delegates secure recovery-code replacement to IAppUserMfaManager.
AuthenticationFlowService is the stable application front door used by the REST endpoint.

sourceReferences.note: Implemented typed handler and canonical transition ownership.
RotateRecoveryCodesAsync performs the real secure recovery-code replacement.
